header.search: Search issues, locations, or ask anything...

hero.title: A Cleaner, Safer, Better Campus
hero.subtitle: Report. Track. Resolve. Powered by AI for a smarter and happier campus.

home.slogan: A cleaner campus today for a brighter tomorrow.
home.title: Campus issues
home.subtitle: Report a problem in Assamese or English, then watch it move from your phone to the person who fixes it.
home.composeHint: Write in any language, or just add a photo.
home.composePlaceholder: e.g. No water in the girls’ hostel washroom since Monday
home.emptyOpenBody: No open public issues right now. Seen something that needs fixing? Report it.
home.emptyResolvedBody: Fixed issues show up here once the reporter confirms them.
home.asideTitle: Write it the way you’d say it.
home.asideBody: AI turns your words or photo into a ticket in both Assamese and English and sends it to the right department with a deadline.
home.asidePrivacy: Public reports are visible to everyone on campus. Private and sensitive reports are seen only by admins.

auth.title: Sign in to CivicSense
auth.subtitle: Report campus issues and follow them until they are fixed, in English or Assamese.
auth.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
auth.errorGeneric: Could not sign you in. Please try again.
auth.errorCallback: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.privacy: We use your email only to sign you in and to send updates about your reports.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.body: This page is only for authorised staff. Ask an administrator if you think this is a mistake.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.adminBody: The admin dashboard arrives in milestone M5.

photo.drop: Drag photos here or choose them.
photo.hint: Up to {max} photos. They are compressed on your device.
photo.tooMany: You can add up to {max} photos.
photo.invalid: Some files could not be used. Choose JPG, PNG or WebP photos.

time.monthsAgo: {count, plural, one {{n} month ago} other {{n} months ago}}

report.title: Report an issue
report.subtitle: Describe the problem in English or Assamese, add a photo if you can. AI fills in the details for you.

description.label: What is the problem?
description.hint: Write in English or Assamese. Say what is wrong and since when.
description.placeholder: e.g. No water in the girls' hostel washroom for three days

location.label: Location
location.hint: Search the building in English or Assamese.
location.empty: No building found. Describe the place below.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.publicHint: Other students can see it and say "Me too". Your name is never shown publicly.
privacy.privateHint: Only you and the staff handling it can see it.
privacy.anonymousHint: Hide your name from staff too. You can still track the report.
privacy.sensitiveHint: Harassment, safety or personal matter — only admins will see it.
privacy.sensitiveAuto: AI thinks this may be sensitive, so we marked it private. You can undo this.

preview.title: AI preview
preview.idle: Write at least {n} characters or add a photo. AI will suggest a title, category and priority.
preview.failed: Could not get the AI preview. You can still submit.
preview.fallback: AI unavailable — we'll analyse it shortly. You can still submit now.

dup.found: {count, plural, one {{n} similar report found} other {{n} similar reports found}}
dup.title: {count, plural, one {Already reported by {n} person} other {Already reported by {n} people}}
dup.body: Is this the same problem? Say "Me too" to add your support instead of a new report.
dup.people: {count, plural, one {{n} person affected} other {{n} people affected}}
dup.supported: Added your support. We'll keep you posted.
dup.supportFailed: Could not add your support. Try again.

errors.needContent: Write a description or add at least one photo.
errors.uploadPending: Photos are still uploading. Please wait a moment.
errors.uploadFailed: Some photos failed to upload. Retry or remove them.
errors.rateLimited: You can send up to {n} reports per hour. Please try again later.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

report.submitHint: You can follow every step in My reports.

emergency.title: If anyone is in danger, call now
emergency.body: This report goes to campus staff, but it does not send help. For fire, injury, violence or a medical emergency, call:
emergency.bodyShort: Your report does not send help. If anyone is in danger, call:
emergency.none: Emergency numbers are not configured yet. Contact the campus security office.

done.title: Report submitted
done.subtitle: Thank you. We'll notify you at every step.
done.departmentPending: Staff will assign a department soon

my.title: My reports
my.subtitle: Everything you reported, updated live.

emptySearch.title: No matching reports
emptySearch.body: Try a different word or ticket code.

active.title: No open reports
active.body: Spotted a problem on campus? Report it in a few seconds.

resolved.title: Nothing resolved yet
resolved.body: Fixed reports will show up here.

all.title: You haven't reported anything yet
all.body: Report a campus problem and follow it until it is fixed.

my.loadMoreFailed: Could not load more. Try again.

verify.title: Is it really fixed?
verify.body: Tell us if the problem is gone. Your answer closes or reopens the ticket.
verify.ratingHint: How happy are you with how it was handled?
verify.reasonHint: Staff will see this and continue the work.
verify.reasonRequired: Please say what is still wrong (at least 3 characters).
verify.reopenBody: Problem came back? You can reopen within {n} days of closing.
verify.changed: This ticket changed meanwhile. Showing the latest.
verify.failed: Could not update the ticket. Try again.

notFound.title: Ticket not found
notFound.body: This ticket does not exist or you don't have access to it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Updates on your reports.

empty.title: No notifications yet
